messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: The rescue team gathers at the edge of the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept ridge overlooking a shattered skyline of broken spires; ink-stained maps unfurl across a stone.

scenes.caption: Oracle Lamp warns of the city's temptations.
scenes.visual_description: A single glowing eye flickers inside an oil lamp's flame, casting long warnings on cracked cobblestones.

scenes.caption: The Glass Diver arrives through a cracked window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet steps from a fractured pane, coat shimmering with reflected city lights.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scouts the castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox crouches behind toppled banners, blue glass eyes scanning iron-bound doors.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol stomps past in silence.
scenes.visual_description: Empty suits of plate metal march on their own beneath torn royal banners; the fox hides in a gutter.

scenes.caption: Mara charts a path past the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning tower drips violet smoke; Mara presses a brass compass to a map fluttering in unnatural wind.

scenes.caption: The Sleeping Tax Collector blocks an alley, snoring.
scenes.visual_description: A round official slumps against a wall, ledger as pillow, stamped papers fluttering from his sleeves.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver slips through a tall mirror in the plaza.
scenes.visual_description: Ripples spread across an enormous mirror as the coated figure dives into it like water.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a beast in the sky pass overhead.
scenes.visual_description: A great winged shadow ripples across rooftops; Tin Fox's tail-key freezes mid-tick.

scenes.caption: Frightened townsfolk peek from shuttered windows.
scenes.visual_description: Pale faces watch from cracked shutters as Mara signals silence with one inked finger.

scenes.caption: Oracle Lamp reveals a magic door beneath royal banners.
scenes.visual_description: Glowing runes pulse along a stone arch hidden behind drooping crimson cloth.

scenes.caption: The Sleeping Tax Collector mumbles a password in his sleep.
scenes.visual_description: The dozing official drools as the runes brighten in rhythm with his snores; Mara leans in, listening.

scenes.caption: The magic door swings open into a hall of broken glass.
scenes.visual_description: A vast chamber of shattered chandeliers and reflective shards stretches before the team.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver finds the captive trapped in a tall window.
scenes.visual_description: A small figure presses against the inside of stained glass; the Diver lays a gloved hand to its surface.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox triggers the alarm bells of the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: Bells crack and toll above; the clockwork fox sprints across tiles trailing sparks from its tail.

scenes.caption: The team races toward the river bridge.
scenes.visual_description: Empty armor floods the streets behind them; Mara leads with her compass flaring blue.

scenes.caption: Oracle Lamp lights the way across the crumbling bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone span over black water, lit by the lamp's single eye; the Sleeping Tax Collector is dragged behind on his ledger like a sled.

scenes.caption: Safe on the far shore, the rescuers look back at the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: Dawn breaks over fallen spires; the team stands on a grassy bank, the rescued figure wrapped in Mara's coat.
